contact.mapQuery: G&S Computing, 37 Capital Dr, Aiken, SC 29803

hero.title: Give *the Geeks* a call
hero.lede: Computer repair, custom-built PCs and servers, networks, Wi-Fi and Office 365 for homes and businesses around Aiken. No job is too big or too small, and remote support can fix things without a trip.

items.title: Hardware sales & service
items.text: Full-service hardware support for your PC, which most of our competitors don’t offer.

items.title: Custom builds
items.text: Desktops and servers built to your requirements, for home or business.

items.title: Remote support
items.text: A technician connects to your computer to diagnose and fix problems, no visit needed.

items.title: Structured wiring
items.text: From one new wall port to wiring a new office building from the ground up.

items.title: Wireless solutions
items.text: Mesh Wi-Fi indoors, and long-range outdoor links between buildings across 20+ acres.

items.title: Office 365 & email
items.text: Reliable email on your own domain, shared calendars and Teams, with the move handled for you.

items.title: Cloud backup
items.text: Your files backed up safely off site.

items.title: Managed IT & networks
items.text: Ongoing management, and networks designed for the way you work.
Excellent service! I needed help putting a PC together and they took care of it super quickly.
The G&S Team is great! Kevin always goes above and beyond to help his customers!
We had a great experience with G&S. Great customer service.

items.title: Call us
items.text: Call (803) 641-9943 and tell us what’s wrong.

items.title: Let us connect
items.text: With your permission, a technician connects to your computer remotely.

items.title: Back to work
items.text: We diagnose and fix the problem, with no trip to the shop.

items.q: Do you work on home computers?
items.a: Yes. From a slow laptop to building a new PC, no job is too big or too small.
Often, yes. Long-range outdoor wireless links have saved clients thousands by sharing one internet connection across buildings.
Yes. We’ve moved many clients to more reliable email, including Office 365 on your own domain.

items.q: How do I pay an invoice?
items.a: You can pay online, or call the shop.

sections.title: Computer trouble?
sections.text: Give the Geeks a call: Monday to Thursday 8 to 5, Friday 8 to 4.
